certify.body: the New Hampshire Secretary of State
certify.rule: When the time for a recount or appeal has passed (N.H. Rev. Stat. 659:84); recounts may be asked for until the Friday after the election (660:1).
certify.local_rule: Towns report by 8 a.m. on the day after the election (659:75).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself
